text:
maya: Heads up — I pushed v3q-int4 (light quant) to 5% staging route just now. Looking for a quick sanity pass on MRR, hallucination signal, and latency tail.
andre: Thanks — what's our current baseline window? last 6h or 24h?
sasha: 6h for aggressive canaries, 24h for promo. For staged promote we use 15m rolling for auto-fallback.
maya: Using 6h baseline. Early smoke should be 15m rolling.
smoke-bot: quick-smoke results attached:```
model: v3q-int4
traffic: 5% staging
metrics (15m rolling vs baseline):
  MRR_delta: -0.9%
  latency_p50: +2ms
  latency_p95: +6ms
  latency_p99: +12ms
  halluc_rate: +0.6pp
  top-1-accuracy-proxy: -0.2%
  sample_count: 4.2k
  p_value(MRR): 0.04
```
maya: raw looks OK but p99 +12ms is annoying. halluc +0.6pp is borderline.
andre: current auto-fallback rule is: absolute MRR drop >1.0% OR halluc_rate increase >1.0pp OR latency_p99 increase >25ms -> immediate rollback. (15m window)
sasha: Those are aggressive; we should consider a "gentle rollback" path that gradients traffic down before hard rollback to avoid oscillation.
maya: Proposal: two-stage fallback: 1) soft-degrade: if any single metric exceeds a soft threshold (MRR_drop >=0.7% OR halluc >=0.5pp OR p99 >=10ms) for 15m -> reduce traffic to 1% for 30m and escalate alerts. 2) hard-rollback if same metric stays beyond hard threshold (MRR_drop >=1.0% OR halluc >=1.0pp OR p99 >=25ms) for 10m at 1% traffic.
oliver: love that. Add rule: require either (a) a single metric exceeding hard threshold OR (b) two metrics exceeding soft thresholds simultaneously to trigger hard-rollback. Prevents noisy single-point flukes.
sasha: Can we add a small statistical safeguard? e.g., require sample_count >= 1k in the 15m window or p-value < 0.05 for MRR-based decisions.
maya: Yes — add sample_count floor and p-value check for MRR. If sample_count <1k, only do soft-degrade (no hard rollback).
andre: Implementation notes: router needs new policy flags: `soft_thresholds`, `hard_thresholds`, `soft_hold_minutes`, `hard_hold_minutes`, `min_samples`. I'll add to rollout-config schema and infra patch.
maya: Also include a manual override tag `force-hold` for oncall to pin traffic.
smoke-bot: tagging summary: @sasha @andre @oliver — current state: soft threshold breached (p99 +12ms, halluc +0.6pp), sample_count 4.2k -> trigger soft-degrade to 1% for 30m. No hard rollback.
sasha: Great. Can someone add the soft/hard thresholds to the canary runbook and the rollout UI? I'll schedule a quick 10m sync at 11:30 to confirm. :thumbsup:
maya: I'll push the router policy and a short test in staging then ping here when live.
andre: I'll prepare the infra rollout and add tests around `min_samples` and p-value gating.
oliver: reminder: log the reason code in trace (reason=soft-degrade|hard-rollback) so we can filter in Redwood Console.
maya: Yep. After the 30m soft window, we evaluate again; if metrics revert we slowly ramp. If not, follow the hard rules.
sasha: Perfect. Thanks all.
maya: Filing quick follow-up ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-ONB-1234 for implementation + runbook updates.
smoke-bot: deploy-bot: routing-change applied -> v3q-int4 = 1% (soft-degrade) at 1767529500.
maya: noted. I'll monitor the dashboard and post update in 15m.
